trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the in-game trophy list as the master checklist and earn every other listed award. Work through story missions, then sweep activities, exploration, and remaining optional tasks. Check the tracker after each milestone; the exact 100% rules and any one-time conditions still need launch-day verification.
trophies.source: Rockstar trophy pattern

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Begin a new story and follow the opening objectives for Gone Fishing. Complete each prompted interaction and stay with the mission until its completion screen or next story handoff. This is an opening-story award, so it should arrive naturally; its scene details are not disclosed here.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Gone Fishing

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the main story through the remaining Chapter 1 objectives. Use the map and active mission prompt to return to the next required job if free roam interrupts your route. The chapter boundary should award this automatically; avoid treating side content as a substitute for the chapter finale.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Chapter 1

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Follow the main-story marker until Chapter 2 is complete. If several missions are available, prioritize the active story thread and check the pause-menu progress screen for the chapter transition. The list supplies the chapter name only, so mission order and any branching requirements should be confirmed in-game.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Chapter 2

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Keep advancing the main story through Chapter 3. Complete required mission objectives rather than leaving during a set piece, and confirm the chapter completion banner before moving on. This guide does not assume a particular ending or character choice.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Chapter 3

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Continue the central story until Chapter 4 closes. Follow the current objective marker and finish the mission rather than just reaching its location. The exact chapter mission count is unknown, so use the in-game story tracker to spot any remaining required step.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Chapter 4

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the remaining main-story missions and start the finale when the game makes it available. As a series-based precaution, stock up and save before launch, then complete every objective through the result screen. The supplied list confirms a final-mission requirement but gives no story outcome or branch details.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA V story finale

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Find and launch Breakfast Run from the active story mission marker. Stay with the mission objectives until the completion result registers, then check the trophy list before leaving the area. The name and requirement are confirmed; its location and steps should be followed from the live map.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Breakfast Run

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then start it from its mission marker. Bring the loadout the game recommends and finish all objective stages without abandoning the job. The list confirms completion is sufficient; specific heist tactics are intentionally left to the mission prompts.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming The Cartel Heist

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Advance to Child's Play and launch the mission from its marker. Follow each prompted objective and let the mission fully resolve before switching activities. No ending detail is needed for this trophy; the supplied list says only to complete the mission.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Child’s Play

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Continue the story until Headliners is available. Start it through the mission prompt and complete the whole job, including any objective that appears after a cutscene. Check the award screen before moving on; the guide does not infer extra medal conditions.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Headliners

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story mission flow and launch it from the map. Complete the required takedown objectives and wait for the mission completion state to register. The trophy requirement does not specify a rank or stealth condition, so do not add one unless the game says so.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming VCIA Takedown

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow the story until Operation Savage Glory becomes available. Complete the mission's displayed objectives in sequence and remain in the mission until the results handoff. The list states completion alone is required; its exact combat route remains to be learned in-game.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the in-game 100% tracker to see which story, activity, and exploration categories remain. Clear the listed requirements one category at a time, then revisit the tracker to confirm each batch counted. Similar games often define completion by a specific checklist rather than every map icon, so verify the live tracker instead of assuming.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA V 100% checklist

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Use the map or activity menu to locate stunt opportunities, then complete and record stunts as you explore. Keep a running count in the game's challenge tracker and vary locations rather than repeating one jump if it does not register as distinct. The total is 250, so leave this for planned cleanup and verify the counter regularly.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA stunt challenges

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Open the activities list and identify each distinct activity type the game tracks. Try one complete session of every type, then check the challenge or activity log for confirmation. The supplied description mentions nine types; use the live list as the authority if labels differ.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA V activity checklist

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit a Shooting Range and review every challenge in its menu. Replay each course until the result screen records gold, keeping a short list of medals still missing. The supplied list gives a total of 42; expect to revisit weapon types and adjust aim settings between attempts.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA V shooting range medals

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find Top Fun drone-race starts through the activity markers and note each location you have cleared. Win a race at every listed venue, checking the map or activity log for the total after each finish. The list gives 14 locations; do not count a race unless its result records a win.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming 14 Top Fun locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Enter races from their map markers or activity menu and aim for a win in 20 different events. Keep a written or in-game record of event names because repeating the same race may not count as a different one. If a result fails to register, finish another distinct race and inspect the tracker.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA race activities

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Locate Cal through the relevant activity or character marker and start a fishing challenge. Learn the event's catch and timing rules from its prompts, then beat Cal's result before the challenge ends. The trophy confirms the opponent and activity; bait, location, and scoring rules should be checked on arrival.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Cal’s fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine or arcade activity marker and start a game. Reach its completion state rather than simply opening or quitting the cabinet, then confirm the trophy notification. The game type is unspecified in the list, so choose a short mode and follow its own rules.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA arcade minigames

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Progress Andy's side-mission strand whenever its marker appears and complete its earlier jobs to unlock the final one. Return to the character's marker after story progress if the strand pauses, then finish the last mission. Its availability and exact order are not stated in the trophy text, so use the map and journal.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Andy’s final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Find Kenton's stranger strand and work through its missions until the final mission unlocks. Recheck the map after major story chapters if no follow-up marker is visible, then complete the finale. The list does not establish whether this strand is missable; prioritize it when convenient and verify its status in the journal.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Kenton’s final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Pick up Billy's side missions from their map or character marker and complete each prerequisite in the strand. Return after story milestones to reveal any new step, then finish the final mission and confirm the award. The exact unlock conditions are not given, so keep the mission journal as your route map.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Billy’s final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Use the map and journal to find stranger mission strands around Leonida. Complete eight separate strands through their final steps and track them individually, since a strand is more than a single encounter. Leave optional characters active on your map and revisit after story progress; one-time availability is not confirmed.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA V Strangers and Freaks

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Locate Randy's side-mission marker and complete the earlier Supply & Demand jobs to open the finale. Check the journal for any waiting prerequisite, then finish Randy's last mission. The listed requirement confirms the final step only; timing and any story gate are still in-game discoveries.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Randy’s final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Find Tyrone's mission strand and complete its available jobs in order. If the marker disappears, check the journal and advance the main story before returning to the last known area. Complete the strand finale and verify the trophy pop; the list does not describe extra conditions.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Tyrone’s final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit each meditation spot as you explore and interact with it until the activity registers. Keep a simple regional checklist so you can tell which locations remain, then revisit any spot that did not update the tracker. The supplied list names 18 spots; exact locations and any required interaction sequence must be confirmed in the released game.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming 18 meditation spots

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret's activity marker to the hunting task and identify the unique animal using the mission clues. Equip the required hunting tool, approach carefully, and complete the hunt as the objective specifies. Because the target is unique, avoid experimenting with lethal weapons before confirming the activity rules.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Bret and a unique animal

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect cards while exploring and use the game's collection page to see which sets remain incomplete. Finish three full sets, checking duplicate handling and set totals in the menu before spending time on extra pickups. A map route or community checklist may help at launch, but this guide makes no unverified location claims.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA collectible sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK It app or feature when it becomes available and use it at distinct locations across the map. Keep a simple region-by-region count and confirm each successful check-in in its interface. The requirement is 100 locations; avoid repeating a spot unless the counter proves repeats qualify.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming WAiNK It

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Use the Challenges menu to identify available tasks and complete any 50 that the tracker accepts. Work on these alongside other goals so incidental progress counts, then review the counter before targeting the final few. The list does not specify unique categories, so follow the in-game definition of a completed challenge.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA challenge trackers

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, deliberately build the Wanted Level to four stars in a place with several escape routes. Break line of sight and use cover or alleys until the search ends, keeping your partner with you throughout. Start this only after learning how partner switching and wanted levels work; the list does not say whether this is story-gated.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA wanted-level escapes

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner to three nearby shops and begin the robbery sequence at each without letting the Wanted Level clear between stops. Plan a short route and keep moving after each hold-up, since losing the active level breaks the stated chain. Exact shop rules are unconfirmed, so follow each on-screen robbery prompt and watch the level indicator.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA chained robberies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive or ride vehicles you have not encountered before and check the vehicle tracker for new entries. Vary vehicle classes and regions, since repeating a familiar model may not add discovery progress. The supplied list sets a target of 100 vehicles; whether variants count separately should be checked against the live tracker.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA vehicle discovery

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait until Combat Focus is available and choose a crowded encounter with five manageable enemies. Activate the ability before engaging, then take down all five before its effect ends; use cover and a reliable weapon to avoid wasting the window. Practice on low-risk enemies and watch the ability meter for timing.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Combat Focus

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Travel to VCIA and explore the public terminal and vehicle areas for a way to depart outside the normal schedule. Follow any interaction prompt that creates an unscheduled exit, then escape the area as the game directs. The phrase is deliberately ambiguous in the trophy text, so avoid risking a wanted-level chain until the trigger is understood.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming VCIA

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The title hints at a Rhino encounter, but the supplied requirement gives no action beyond its joke description. Once a tank is available, use a safe open area and test the challenge prompt or tracker before committing to a long fight. This is a cautious inferred route; the exact trigger must be confirmed in-game.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: GTA tank challenges

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Locate the jewelry store and scout entrances, exits, and any security prompts before starting the robbery. Use stealth controls, stay out of sight, and leave the premises without triggering detection; restart from a save if the attempt goes loud. The list confirms the stealth condition but not the store or tools, so rely on the live objective cues.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA stealth robberies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Find bank-vault opportunities through their activity markers and complete five separate vault robberies. Plan an escape route for each and confirm the escape state before starting the next; keep a counter because the trophy requires five successful getaways. The list does not describe repeatability, so check the activity tracker for distinct vaults or completions.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA heists

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Watch for an armored-truck event or marker and begin the robbery when you have a clear escape route. Complete the truck objective, collect any required payout, then lose pursuit and wait for the escape confirmation. The trophy says escape is required, so simply stopping the vehicle is not enough.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA armored-car events

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every named region and use the map's area labels or discovery tracker to find gaps. Travel through the center of unexplored zones rather than skimming boundaries, then check whether all 52 areas have registered. Pair this with vehicle discoveries and collectibles to reduce backtracking.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming 52 areas

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Identify each gang and its illegal-operation activity through map clues or mission leads. Complete one robbery tied to every gang, recording names as you go and confirming nine total in the tracker. These encounters may be risky; prepare an escape route and leave the area after each success.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming nine gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and look for a place or interaction that offers a cocktail with an ocean view. Use the relevant social or purchase prompt, then pause long enough for the game to register the scenic drink. The list names the location and action, while the exact venue is left for exploration.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Ocean Beach

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom and inspect its doors, windows, and nearby vehicles before starting trouble. Use the classic smash-through approach suggested by the description, then get clear of the property if pursuit begins. The list confirms the showroom escape concept but not the required vehicle or entry side.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA vehicle showroom stunts

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Travel to Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and start a bowling session. Complete the follow-through action requested by the game's controls or tutorial, then check the activity result for registration. The trophy wording suggests a specific interaction; do not leave after merely entering the venue.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points to a partnership activity but does not identify the trigger or required score. Keep playing shared story or partner activities and inspect the trophy tracker after moments that involve both characters. Treat any specific unlock theory as unconfirmed until the game reveals a matching hint.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: partner achievements

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description frames this as a choice-based award but does not state which choice or threshold counts. Make choices during story and side content, then review the trophy tracker for progress before repeating similar interactions. Since decisions can be difficult to reverse, keep a separate save before testing any suspected one-time trigger.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: GTA choice tracking

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The wording suggests an action that succeeds on a second attempt, but gives no activity name. When a task explicitly offers a retry, fail or cancel the first attempt safely and complete the next attempt successfully, then check for the pop. Avoid forcing this on a story mission until the tracker hints at the intended activity.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: retry achievements

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Explore unusual locations and investigate events that look out of place, especially when the game presents a clear interaction or witness prompt. Stay nearby until the event fully resolves and check the tracker afterward. The description gives no coordinates or explanation, so this guide avoids inventing a specific mystery or story reveal.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: GTA easter-egg trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Look for a safe stretch of road and a pedestrian encounter where a melee action can be performed from a moving vehicle. Use the game's drive-by melee control shown in its control guide, connect once, and stop before causing a larger incident. The pun does not reveal the exact input or vehicle requirement, so test in a low-risk area.
trophies.source: Official trophy list wording; series precedent: GTA drive-by actions

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect marked bills through the activities that award them and build a cash buffer before laundering. Use the contacts or laundering service named by the game, repeating transactions until the tracker reaches $250,000 processed. Check that the counter measures laundered marked bills rather than ordinary spending, and keep funds available for fees.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming marked bills and contacts

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Visit different shop types and purchase useful or inexpensive items while tracking total spend. Check the trophy counter after each category because the $100,000 must be across all shops, not necessarily in one visit. Avoid spending all available cash before properties and other progression purchases are complete.
trophies.source: Official trophy list; series precedent: GTA shopping spend goals

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Find garage properties through map and property menus, then purchase each one you can afford. Keep a list of owned garages and revisit the property interface for any remaining entries; the supplied list specifies eight. Save this as a late-game cash sink after required upgrades and activity costs are covered.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming eight garage properties

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app when it becomes available and follow its registration prompt for an eligible vehicle. Register ten vehicles, checking the app after each one so you can spot any that did not count. The supplied list confirms the app and target; vehicle eligibility and whether duplicates qualify need launch-day verification.
trophies.source: Official trophy list naming Scooter Bros app
